title: UIBC verify report line
description: One line of a JSON Lines file produced by `uibc_core.pyz verify --report`. The line describes one vector and the verifier that judged it. It deliberately carries no aggregate: a harness that wants a score computes its own, because a score is a claim about the harness, not about the verifier.

vector.description: The caller's name for the package, from --vector-id. Defaults to the package path, so a consumer should not parse it.

result.description: INCONCLUSIVE means the verifier ran but could not reach a verdict (usually an unsigned package stopping at S6). ERROR means the verifier could not read the input at all. Neither is a pass.

checks_failed.description: The check ids that reported FAIL. Empty when the verdict is PASS, INCONCLUSIVE or ERROR.

verifier_id.description: Who produced this line. A report whose producer is not named is a claim without a claimant.

exit.description: 0 PASS, 1 judged and not PASS, 3 the input could not be read. A consumer that only wants pass/fail reads this, not `result`.

error.description: The reason, present exactly when result is ERROR.

then.description: a FAIL line with no failing check names nothing
